searchText: Another 1559 PR that has been sitting for a while... https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3231 I saw it was approved this is why i did nothing It was not approved by any author ? Correct. To auto-merge an author needs to approve. Ok, there is a label to quickly filter what's need a review from an author, right ? Was it used on that one ? My mental filter was to look at PRs without approvals, but it is not good actually `is:pr is:open mention:@me` in the PR search filter if you want. The bot will mention you (and all other authors). Alternatively, ensure your GitHub notifications are setup so you get an email when you are mentioned. That filter isn't perfect, since it includes PRs where you are mentioned by not-the-bot, but it gets close. (fixed) Thanks a lot
